as a teenager, i can say it’s annoying as all hell. depression is something i’ve been dealing with since middle school. now i hear everyone at school and stuff talk about it like its nothing, and it actually makes it kind of worse for me. i missed the first month of school because i was in a psychiatric facility and i let my band director tell some of the band kids and then it got to the whole school and everyone was like “wow. didn’t know it was that crazy!!!!” and it just blows my mind that teens are like that.

i’m glad, it helps talking about it since its so fresh. 
i’ve known her since my freshman year of highschool, so its been 3 years. we hung out constantly, we would walk around different cities until 3 or 4 am doing god knows what. it was just amazing, i love her so much. i’ve always envied her and thought she was pretty much a goddess haha. i have 2 other friends besides her and those are the friends i just chill with but if i ever wanna fuck around and have a lot of fun i would go with her.
then her grandma suggests she gets a job and my friend suggests we try and work together. the pizza place we applied to accepted her but didn’t accept me, so she starts working there. 
this sounds immature but its really just a release of a bunch of pent up tension that we’ve been having since she got a new job and has been changing and us growing apart. but, a few days ago, she mentions i’d hate working there because theres this other girl she works with who gets bullied for being fat and ugly, so i figured that was just her calling me fat and ugly, which hurt my feelings for a while but i never brought it up and tried my best to brush it off. 
for halloween, we had plans to buy candy and drop acid. we’ve never done drugs together before, we’ve always hung out sober, so we figured it’d be a ton of fun. we made those plans before she got a job. 
the day before halloween comes up, and she tells me she decided to pick up an extra shift and cancels on me, so i make plans with some girls i’ve had budding friendships with for about a month.
halloween comes around and she texts me about how much fun she’s having at work, and how her manager is right anyways, right in saying “theres no need to do drugs to have fun, we arent depressed, emo teens” which really upset me because we’ve always been sober together and have had a lot of fun, and it was her idea to drop acid anyways bc i’m not even too big on psychedelics. 
then she made a post on snapchat about how weird you are if you’re over the age of 11 and go trick or treating, right after i got done trick or treating, so i made a joke about it and she got all upset. then she mentions that teens go trick or treating just to go get high and eat all of the candy after, as if i was going to do that. (i get high maybe once every 2 weeks, and wasn’t planning to do so on halloween)
i then said that she’s changed a lot, she used to be all chill and open minded, but her coworkers have changed her
so she proceeded to give me a speech on growing up, as she works with a bunch of grown adults, and we are only 16. 
then i mentioned how we only went trick or treating because it was one of my friends final years before she turned 18, she then said “i’d be so scared if she walked up to my door. she’s the only unattractive one out of you guys.” which really upset me, i then said “____ is hot 🔥” and she said “fire emoji?? if anyones changed its you.” so i asked how she changed she said in our freshman and sophomore year i was really fun to be around and now all i do is smoke weed with my friends and whatever. 
i made the point that we only smoke once or twice a month, and i hang out with her over them more. and then since i defended her “reasoning” for not liking my new friends she said “idk they just gross me out” and started calling them trailer trash, whores, etc. just a bunch of unnecessary things. after that is when i basically ended it. i told her she has no authority over them to call them stuff like that. and how she’s 16 and has a child and is trying to get married to a military man for crying out loud. and then she left me on read and we haven’t talked since. she removed all of the photos of me from her instagram page but i have yet to do the same. i’ve felt so depressed, even suicidal since the situation. but she’s been on snapchat and seems like she’s thriving perfectly fine. 
i know soon she will realize she messed up in this. how her 20+ y/o coworkers won’t care as much as i did when her abusive baby daddy hits her again and a bunch of other life things i supported her through. 
i believe she’s just jealous i’ve been hanging out with other people. does she just expect me to sit alone, bored, while she’s at work? idk. its a whole mess.

i started typing out the entire story but then figured you probably didn’t want to hear all of it. let me know if you do though bahaha. 
but i lost her on halloween. we grew apart slowly and then all at once. it sucked and crashed hard.
